name: IEEE-754 Bit Manipulation Octree Traversal
aliases: Octree Ray Tracing with Bitwise Cell Indexing
Ray Traversal in Octree using IEEE-754 Bit Manipulation
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for an octree structure that uses the bit representation of floating-point coordinates to determine node depth and child indices, avoiding explicit pointer chasing or coordinate division.
summary: IEEE-754 Bit Manipulation Octree Traversal uses floating-point mantissa bits to determine node depth and child indices, replacing arithmetic division and dynamic stacks with deterministic bitwise operations.
